title: Eimco Elecon (India) Ltd (NSE: EIMCOELECO) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: Eimco Elecon (India) Ltd commands ~65–70% of India's intermediate underground coal loader market with zero net debt and ₹206 Cr of treasury cash. While its order book surged +202% YoY to ₹133 Cr, heavy working capital (326 gross days; ₹2 Cr H1 FY27 CFO) and 8.98% ROE cap business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL. At ₹2,528.10 (34.65x TTM P/E), our ₹2,750 Base Case versus ₹1,600 Bear Case fails the 1.5:1 risk-reward hurdle even at support. We hold 0 shares (NOT_HELD), REJECT new capital (TIER_0), and keep 100% of marginal cash dry.
